_README: Copy this file to meta_secrets.json and fill in. NEVER commit meta_secrets.json. Use the ROTATED token, not the leaked one.
_token_note: Long-lived System User token. Scopes needed: whatsapp_business_management, instagram_basic, instagram_manage_insights, pages_read_engagement, read_insights, ads_read.
_ig_note: Graph API Explorer: GET /me/accounts -> page id; GET /{page_id}?fields=instagram_business_account -> ig_user_id.
_page_note: GET /me/accounts returns each page id + its page access token. Leave page_access_token blank to fall back to access_token.
_ads_note: Format act_XXXXXXXX or just the number. GET /me/adaccounts to list. Needs ads_read.
